tool_args.rationale: The pilot reaches s_grad 2.44, just below the reported critical range of 2.50–2.68. High-gradient observations are needed to determine whether a supercritical siphon changes the response.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the supercritical avalanche model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All pilot gradients are below the stated critical range, so the threshold and avalanche strength are not identifiable.
The high-gradient probe directly tests the unresolved threshold at lower cost.
The pilot curve alone does not distinguish these from a thresholded avalanche mechanism.
